title: feuilleea chilensis
intro: Feuilleea chilensis, commonly known as Chilean guanabara or Chilean lavender, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Annonaceae. This plant is valued for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress and anxiety, and support immune function.
